question: Why does accomplishment fail when the śakti-mantra is prioritized first?
premises: Accomplishment is sought by the practitioner
Prioritizing it prevents accomplishment from arising
inference: Placing the śakti-mantra first obstructs the attainment of accomplishment.
uncertainties: niddhir may be a variant spelling of siddhir
plain_english: If one places the śakti-mantra first, accomplishment does not arise for him.
